description: Hand-built edge cases for the KPI engine and import parser (E-00-06 AC-4). Cells: number = score, "RUN" = run sprint, null = not scored.

bandFromTwoDecimalAverage.why: Exact average 7.995 displays as 8.00, so the band must be Outstanding (ADR-016).

bandJustBelowBoundary.why: Exact average 7.9933… displays as 7.99, so the band is Exceeds.

exactOrderingBeatsDisplayedTie.why: Both display 9.00; the sheet ranks the exact 9.00 (Mandip) above 8.9956 (Sajjan) — rank on the exact average (ADR-016).

competitionRankingTie.why: Identical exact average and total share a rank; the next rank is skipped (1, 2, 2, 4).

precisionCell.why: Workbook cell E44 holds 5.975 (displayed 5.98): stored as 598 with a PRECISION_ROUNDED warning. Half-up uses an epsilon because naive Math.round fails for values such as 1.005 (100.4999…).

runOnlyRow.why: RUN cells are excluded from every metric but counted as run sprints.

singleSprintEngineer.why: One scored sprint: averages defined, momentum/prior3/spread undefined.
